I think the most imoprtant lesson for the Logician Archetype (includes scientis, math, and geeneral thinkiner...) is that one has the most remarkable engine; imagination. and yet in it's brilliance, as with all archetypes in stories; goes terribly wrong if it is self-referntial, or all knowing or isolated.

# Tangibility as the Axiom
Becuase we tend to think in highly abstract, odd scapes... The most important thing is to get hands-on with life. Suffer (within reason) is not inherently wrong when viwed from this lens. Rejoice, for even to suffer is to see what is real!
